_meta.sources: live mcp__claude_ai_ElevenLabs__creative_generate_speech schema (prompt, model_id, voice_id, context, generations_count, estimate_only); an MCP estimate_only preflight (48.9951 credits for 49 chars, ~1 credit/char, 2026-10-08)
_meta.model_rule: The TTS model ALWAYS comes from the project's voice profile (project.json voices[].model), never a code or provider default. Resolve explicit production choices into that profile for the requested scope. ElevenLabs recommends v4 for new work; v3 remains valid when the project/voice selects it. Earlier runbooks pin v3; they do not select the model for other projects.
_meta.generations_count_note: MCP tool default generations_count is 4 (= 4x cost). Always pin 1 unless the user asks for more takes.
_meta.routes_note: Direct ElevenLabs routes only; OpenRouter TTS/STT ids and supported voices are in openrouter.json (no music/SFX/voice library there). mcp = claude.ai ElevenLabs connector (creative_generate_speech; outputs are flow URLs that expire ~2 h, so asset-persist must run); web = elevenlabs.io in a signed-in browser via clipboard paste (never typed key-by-key), the fallback when no connector is available.
_meta.tool_names_note: Tool names here are those of Claude's ElevenLabs connector (claude.ai Settings > Connectors), which Claude Code shows as mcp__claude_ai_ElevenLabs__creative_*. If ElevenLabs' MCP server is added to Claude Code directly, the same creative_* tools appear under that server's own prefix (for example mcp__elevenlabs__creative_generate_speech): match on the creative_* name. Other ElevenLabs MCP servers expose different tools; with none of the creative_* tools available, use route web.
_meta.tagging_sources: [verified] Supplied official-source facts dated 2026-10-17; citations and evidence labels: ../elevenlabs-tagging.md. No network recheck in this edit.

tts_notes._source: [verified] Official-source facts supplied 2026-10-17; ../elevenlabs-tagging.md. Route availability must be checked in the connector/UI; a public id does not prove MCP exposure.
tts_notes.eleven_v3: [verified] Free-form bracket tag syntax shared with v4; 70+ languages; PVCs not fully optimized. Valid when selected by the voice profile. [maintainer-observed] Delivery is model-specific; see ../elevenlabs-tagging.md for model-change listening review.
tts_notes.eleven_v4: [verified] Recommended by ElevenLabs for new work; same tag syntax as v3, more reliable following of tags including unfamiliar deliveries; 90+ languages. No speed control; omit speed. Never a code default. [maintainer-observed] Delivery is model-specific; see ../elevenlabs-tagging.md for model-change listening review.
tts_notes.eleven_v4_turbo: [verified] Tag-capable v4 family; no speed control; omit speed. [unverified] Direct-API request limit and MCP/web availability; confirm selected route.
tts_notes.eleven_multilingual_v2: [verified] No audio tags; do not inherit the MCP tool default. [inferred] Unsupported tags may be read aloud; strip/convert them.
tts_notes.eleven_flash_v2: [verified] No audio tags; <phoneme> supported only on this model.

max_chunk_chars.basis: Repository conservative targets, NOT vendor request limits or model defaults. v3 2,700: production-runbook observation of unreliable finalization near 5,000. v4/v4 Turbo 4,000: [inferred] derived well below the 10,000 OpenRouter limit, untested repository choice. Direct v4 Turbo limit [unverified]; confirm before use. Project audio.chunking/audio.max_chunk_chars apply within route limits.

request_limits.basis: [verified] ElevenLabs models page: v3/v4; Text to Dialogue: total across inputs[].text, each turn has voice_id. [unverified] Direct v4 Turbo limit; 10,000 is verified only for OpenRouter. See ../elevenlabs-tagging.md; do not infer direct-route limits from OpenRouter. [unverified] Other direct-route ceilings are null here; OpenRouter ceilings are recorded separately.

_meta.sources: live mcp__claude_ai_ElevenLabs__creative_get_flow_node_types + creative_get_model_schema (music, sfx; read-only, 2026-10-08); elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/capabilities/sound-effects (SFX price, 30 s max); elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/capabilities/music (model family, 3 s - 5 min)
_meta.model_rule: The music/SFX model comes from the project (project.json audio.music_model / audio.sfx_model) when set, else `default` below. Never a silent swap: an id not in `models` is refused.
_meta.generations_count_note: creative_run_flow_nodes defaults generations_count to 4 (= 4x cost). Pin 1 unless the user asks for more takes on that step.
_meta.id_note: MCP/flow ids are eleven_music_v2_5 / eleven_text_to_sound_v2; the public REST API names the newest music model music_v2_5. Use the MCP ids on the mcp route.

credits.basis: no official per-second or per-track price found in ElevenLabs docs (2026-10-08); price every run with creative_run_flow_nodes estimate_only:true before approval

music.duration_note: MCP schema allows up to 600 s; the docs say 5 min. Keep cues short (one cue per beat, per audio-post-mix) and stay under 300 s.
music.notes: Music cues and whole tracks (3 s - 5 min per the docs); price comes from the estimate_only preflight.

credits_per_second.basis: elevenlabs.io docs, sound effects: '40 credits per second when duration is specified' (read 2026-10-08)

sfx.notes: Sound effects up to 30 s; 40 credits per second when the duration is set.

web.method: Claude drives Music / Sound Effects in the user's signed-in browser (Claude in Chrome, or a headless browser) and downloads the files

tag_profiles._note: [measured-controlled] one voice (sarah), one sentence, 1-2 takes per case; not listening judgements. Full numbers and checklist: ../elevenlabs-tagging.md. Director applies the profile; this block never selects a model.

eleven_v4.quiet_tags: mostly unvoiced/breathy (~5-14% voiced); not a sleep default

eleven_v4_turbo.quiet_tags: [unverified] not in the measured set; audition
